top_signals.title: Bond Vigilantes Are Back. What's Driving the Selloff and What's the Impact on Stocks?
top_signals.summary: The yield on 30-year US Treasuries hit the highest in almost two decades, reflecting investor angst. Bloomberg News reporters and experts unpack what’s driving the selloff — from government debt to Big Tech’s AI spending binge — and whether it will derail global stock markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Racist abuse spurred Suzuki as Japan goalkeeper set for Premier League
top_signals.summary: Zion Suzuki has had to overcome costly mistakes and racist abuse on the way to becoming the most expensive Japanese goalkeeper in history.
